commands.name: list show
commands.summary: Read the person's shopping list: each item's id, name, quantity, unit and whether it is checked.

show.description: Which items to list; all of them when left out.

commands.name: list add
commands.summary: Add one item to the person's shopping list. Give the name as the person said it; leave quantity and unit out when they gave none.

args.name: name
args.description: What to buy, as the person said it, such as "oat milk".

unit.description: The unit of the quantity, such as g, cups or cans.

idempotency-key.description: Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, and the item is added once.

commands.name: list share
commands.summary: Share the person's shopping list with another person, who can then see and change it.

args.name: with
args.description: The email address of the person to share with.

can-edit.description: Whether they may change the list, not only see it.

message.description: A note to send with the invitation. It may run over several lines.

list order.reason: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can.
list order.how: with Place order on the shopping list
